functionalRequirement: User shall/will be able to open various types of accounts like savings, fixed deposit, etc.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support the creation of all specified account types (e.g., savings, fixed deposit) with 100% coverage of required fields and configurations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle multiple account types, necessitating full functional coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that account creation processes adhere to predefined business rules (e.g., minimum balance for savings accounts) with 100% accuracy.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for accurate implementation of account-specific rules and constraints.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a user-friendly interface for account creation, with clear labels and instructions for each account type.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, requiring ease of operation to ensure a positive user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for account creation requests 99.9% of the time during business hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to account creation functionality, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all user data during account creation and storage using AES-256 encryption.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling sensitive user information, requiring robust data protection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow the addition of new account types with minimal code changes, ensuring modularity and scalability.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies potential future expansion of account types, requiring a maintainable design.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow users to add expenses with details including amount, date, payer, and optional split among participants.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support the addition of expenses with all specified details (amount, date, payer, and optional split) for 100% of use cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires the system to handle expense details comprehensively, necessitating full functional coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Correctness: The system must ensure that expense calculations (e.g., splits) are accurate to within 0.01 units of currency for 99.9% of valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies the need for precise calculations, especially when splitting expenses among participants.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process expense addition requests in less than 200 milliseconds for up to 500 concurrent users.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time expense management, requiring timely responses for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide a clear and intuitive interface for adding expenses, with consistent input fields and validation messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user interaction, requiring ease of operation to ensure a positive user experience.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must handle invalid or incomplete expense entries gracefully, providing appropriate error messages without crashing.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves user input, requiring robustness to handle errors effectively.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must ensure that expense data cannot be altered or deleted without proper authorization.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves financial data, requiring protection against unauthorized modifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Testability: The system must include automated unit tests for expense addition functionality, ensuring coverage of all edge cases.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical functionality, requiring thorough testing to ensure reliability.
